name: Samaritan Health Center
evidence: Mission: "show the love of Christ" through healthcare. Services list primary care, STI testing, vaccines, vision; no contraception mentioned and no pro-life or anti-contraception statement found.

name: Alliance Medical Ministry
evidence: Secular-worded mission (health equity); faith-based partners. Offers volunteer gynecology and well-woman exams (45+); contraception not mentioned; no pro-life statement found.

name: Open Door Clinic (Urban Ministries of Wake County)
evidence: Clinic page lists primary care, behavioral health and gynecological specialty services; contraception not mentioned; no pro-life or faith statement found.

name: Mariam Clinic
evidence: Vision rooted in "traditional Islamic principles of service"; lists Women's Health Services without detail; no contraception or abortion stance found.

name: Shepherd's Care Medical Clinic
evidence: No live official website found (shepherdscareclinic.com is a parked/spam domain), so no stance could be checked; listed on Wake County's free clinic page.

name: NeighborHealth Center
evidence: Christian faith-based practice ("serve Christ") whose OB/GYN and women's health services list "Birth control and family planning"; no pro-life statement found.
